title: mac-screen-search belongs on your radar
description:
This repo should be on your radar: jftuga/mac-screen-search. macOS CLI tool that captures screenshots, performs OCR to find text, and highlights or redacts matches. It has about 4 GitHub stars, and it is active enough to deserve a closer look. Save this for your next build, and follow for more useful developer tools.

https://github.com/jftuga/mac-screen-search
